t: Real Research Today: Laser Highway Networks
title: Real Research Today: Laser Highway Networks
definition: Today's documented research behind Laser Highway Networks.
description:
The road to Laser Highway Networks is already being paved. NASA's Artemis program is building the lunar Gateway and surface systems as a deep-space proving ground. CERN's antimatter research (ALPHA, AEgIS) studies antimatter properties relevant to far-future propulsion physics.

The 100 Year Starship project (DARPA/NASA seeded) studies the capabilities needed for interstellar flight within a century. Together these programs form the phased arrays foundation that Laser Highway Networks will build on — the sail propulsion results, the beam-riding methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as sail propulsion research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

t: 2032 — First long-duration relay optics testbed runs a sealed laser sta
title: 2032 — First long-duration relay optics testbed runs a sealed laser sta
definition: 2032 milestone on the Laser Highway Networks roadmap.
description:
First long-duration relay optics testbed runs a sealed laser stations habitat for 1,000 days on Earth, proving the phased arrays recycling math.

What must be true first: the phased arrays results have to replicate outside the lab, sail propulsion manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and beam-riding operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed phased arrays demonstrations, sail propulsion cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting beam-riding uptime. When all three flash green, 2032 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (6 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Laser Highway Networks
definition: Estimates Laser Highway Networks readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Laser Highway Networks components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a laser stations that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Laser Highway Networks Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Laser Highway Networks operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Laser Highway Networks installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 61822 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where phased arrays monitoring, sail propulsion redundancy, or beam-riding maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Laser Highway Networks Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Laser Highway Networks: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Laser Highway Networks — chains of laser stations pushing light-sails between stars.

Phase 1 — Prove (phased arrays): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (sail propulsion): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (beam-riding): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (relay optics): laser stations as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and interstellar lanes-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
